title: SciConBench
tagline: A live benchmark for scientific conclusion synthesis
description: SciConBench measures whether AI agents can search the literature, weigh evidence quality, reconcile conflicting findings, and write the expert-level conclusion a systematic review would reach. New reviews are published every month, so the benchmark never stops growing — and neither does the evaluation.

news.text: The August tracking run closed the July 2026 cohort: 34 newly published Cochrane reviews were ingested and merged into the public HuggingFace dataset.
SciConBench-Track goes live. The pipeline now runs on the 1st of every month, discovering new systematic reviews and re-evaluating frontier models under the clean-room protocol.

faq.question: Why does a benchmark need to be live?
faq.answer: Any static benchmark drawn from published literature is already inside the training data of the next model generation. Cochrane publishes new systematic reviews every month, so SciConBench continuously draws fresh questions whose reference conclusions postdate the models being tested. A score here reflects synthesis ability rather than recall of a memorized document.

faq.question: What stops an agent from just finding the answer online?
faq.answer: Every evaluation runs under SciConHarness, a clean-room protocol that proxies web search and page fetching. It filters out the target review, anything citing it, and any source published after the review's date, so the agent has to assemble the conclusion from primary evidence instead of retrieving it.

faq.question: How are models scored?
faq.answer: Both the agent's conclusion and the expert conclusion are decomposed into atomic facts. Factual precision asks how many of the agent's claims the review supports, penalizing outright contradictions; factual recall asks how many of the expert's claims the agent recovered. F1 is their harmonic mean, macro-averaged over reviews.

faq.question: How do I get a model onto the leaderboard?
faq.answer: Open an issue or pull request on GitHub, or email us. Any model reachable through an OpenAI-, Anthropic-, Gemini-, or OpenRouter-compatible API can be added to the monthly roster in one config change.
